description:
Dispatch and track a field workforce from your Bubble app. Tookan is a delivery and field-service management platform for on-demand deliveries, at-home services and on-street customer acquisition. This plugin lets your app create the jobs and read their progress, so an order placed in Bubble becomes a task in a driver's or technician's hands without anyone re-keying it.

Key Features:
📝 Create Tasks: Turn an order, booking or service request into a Tookan task straight from a workflow, complete with addresses, timing and customer details.

📍 Track Progress: Retrieve task details to show live status, assigned agent and delivery information inside your own app.

🚗 Built for the Field: Designed around real dispatch work — deliveries, home services and on-street acquisition.

🔑 Simple Setup: One Tookan API key in the plugin settings connects your account.

Plugin support: https://inova.us/support
instructions:
1- Create tookan account tookanapp.com
2- You can get a key from settings (Login>Menu>Settings>API Keys) in your tookan account

Learn more about tookan API https://tookanapi.docs.apiary.io/#reference/task
